Initial release of Contract Renewal & Expiration Manager

- Structured process to track and manage all vendor contract renewals.
- Automated 90/60/30-day alert protocol for proactive renewal decisions and renegotiations.
- Scoring-based decision framework to assess renewal, renegotiation, or replacement.
- Renegotiation preparation package with market comparison and value analysis.
- Renewal and escalation documentation templates included.
- Comprehensive implementation checklist for onboarding the system.
